title: Three-page book embedding with a fixed vertex order
formal: Given a graph and a fixed linear order of its vertices, what is the computational complexity of partitioning its edges into at most three sets, each containing no pair of alternating edges in that order?
context:
This is equivalent to 3-coloring the associated circle graph. Local book thickness, an unfixed order and upward book embeddings are different problems.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
